purpose: Replace the blocked median-support M5-R1 real replay selection with a label-blind, observed-dropout-enriched recorded-sequence development replay while preserving the frozen phase-1 methods.

predecessor.reason: The frozen per-object median-support selector chose 15 complete-observation tracks even though the audited pool contains tracks with natural input dropouts.

source.clock: Sort each associated physical track by common frame ID and map source-frame ordinal differences to a nominal 20 Hz clock; hardware timestamps are unavailable.
source.coordinate_frame: Transform each independent FoundationPose model-to-camera measurement into the dataset world frame using the recorded world-to-camera calibration before temporal filtering.
source.motion_scope: The physical objects are static while the recorded camera viewpoint changes; this tests temporal stabilization and natural missing observations, not moving-object dynamics.

selection.observation_available: Visible input mask area is at least 0.001 of the 1280x720 image, valid-depth ratio inside that mask is at least 0.5, and at least four masked depth pixels are valid.
selection.track_rule: Retain every associated track with at least five available observations and at least one naturally unavailable observation at or after its first available observation.
selection.initialization: Start replay at the first naturally available observation. Earlier unavailable frames are excluded because neither causal method can initialize without a measurement.
selection.outcome_blind: Selection may read scene, object, oracle physical association, frame order, input mask area, and valid-depth support. It may not read FoundationPose predictions, scores, ground-truth pose error, or either temporal method output.

methods.baseline: NEAREST_REPRESENTATIVE_CT using the frozen M5-R1 phase-1 nearest_smooth configuration.
methods.proposed: QUOTIENT_CV_KALMAN using the frozen M5-R1 phase-1 qcvk_balanced configuration.
methods.pose_predictor: FoundationPose with the frozen commit, checkpoints, seed, five refinement iterations, full 252-candidate attention, and resource-bounded warp/score/refine execution used by R2.
methods.symmetry: Use exact discrete transforms from models_eval/models_info.json. For a declared continuous axis, apply a deterministic fixed object-coordinate basis that maps that axis to canonical z, run the byte-frozen z-axis temporal kernels unchanged, then map outputs back to the original object coordinates.

evaluation.primary_loss: For each track, mean sqrt((symmetry-quotient translation error / 0.01 m)^2 + (symmetry-quotient rotation error / 5 deg)^2) across every retained replay frame.
evaluation.primary_aggregation: Compute a track mean, then an equal-weight mean across tracks within each object, then an equal-weight macro mean across the five represented objects.
evaluation.missing_frame_loss: Apply the same track-then-object macro aggregation using only naturally unavailable frames.

bootstrap.unit: Hierarchical paired resampling: sample represented objects with replacement, then sample complete tracks with replacement within each sampled object; preserve all frames and both methods in every sampled track.
bootstrap.reported_bound: 10th percentile of paired relative macro-object improvement.

evaluation.reopen_policy: The first evaluator-label open is final for this protocol. Any method, configuration, selection, symmetry, metric, or gate change requires a new protocol ID and a newly frozen bundle.

claim_boundary.allowed: Observed-dropout-enriched development replay on recorded XYZ-IBD RealSense multi-view sequences with a nominal clock and oracle track association.
forbidden: independent physical-instance count equal to frame or track count

execution_order: freeze protocol, label-blind selection, exact symmetry handling, and evaluator code
build separate inference and evaluator-label streams
run complete label-blind FoundationPose inference for every naturally available retained frame
open evaluator labels exactly once and compare the two frozen temporal methods
generate content and quantitative visualizations only from the completed result
